Introduction of Hangzhou Normal University Editor Notes: The top university & the Alma Mater of Ma Yun. Founded as a teacher training school in 1908, Hangzhou Normal University has a history of over 100 years, which has bestowed the institution with a glorious tradition of producing first-rate teachers and educators at different levels for the whole Chinese nation.
